svg.title: Family relationships and kinship terms in the Tandara family
svg.desc: Relatives by marriage, a family example and traditional kinship terms. Croatian terms are retained with English explanations.
svg.text: Who is related to whom? A guide to traditional kinship terms.
Family example — relationships from Ante’s perspective
Ante and Ivan are pašanci — they married sisters.
Ante is Marko’s svak — his sister’s husband.
What do these traditional terms mean?
A broad term for a relative or someone
A wife’s sister’s husband. Two men
married to sisters are called pašanci.
Blood relatives and related kinship terms
Strina, ujna and tetak refer to the spouses
